vulnerabilities.description: Service method passes parameter 'recipient' directly to a repository save/persist call without validation or field filtering, so any field the caller supplied is persisted as-is.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Validate or filter the entity's fields before persisting it, or map from a DTO that exposes only safe fields.

vulnerabilities.description: Controller method binds @RequestBody directly to entity class 'Account' without DTO layer. This allows clients to modify any field.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Create a AccountDTO class with only modifiable fields. Map DTO to entity in service layer.

vulnerabilities.recommendation: Add @JsonIgnore annotation above the password field to prevent serialization.
